symptom: publishing a specialization and exposing a member its generalization declares passed check and exec, then mx check reported CE1613 "The selected attribute 'M.Sub.Code' no longer exists" — for an inherited attribute and for an inherited association alike
cause: lookupEntityMembers read only the published entity's own attributes and the associations it is directly a side of, so an inherited member fell through to the bare-name attribute fallback and publishedMemberToGen's qualifyMemberName prefixed the published entity
insight: Mendix resolves a member by the entity that DECLARES it, not the one it is used through — the same rule as #1335's cross association. Any member lookup keyed on 'the entity itself' needs the generalization chain (generalizationChain already exists in validate_member_refs.go). The inherited attribute also lost its EdmType, which is CE5016 from 11.12 — a second error hiding behind the first. Proved on mx 11.6.6: 3 CE1613 before, 0 after; describe round-trips because it prints bareMemberName
